name: cucumber avocado smoothie
instructions:
Cucumber + green bell pepper + lime + avocado, all in a blender. Kind of a gazpacho — kind of Nisha Vora's avocado gazpacho (Rainbow Plant Life), approached slowly (see notes).

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- cucumber
- green bell pepper
- LIME (incredibly important — see notes; considering 2 limes)
- avocado

=== PROCEDURE ===

Put it all in a blender.
notes:
=== STATUS — GOOD BUT BLAND, GOING SLOW ===

What I've made so far is good, but it's BLAND. Building up gradually rather than committing to Nisha's full build (see reference below).

=== LIME IS INCREDIBLY IMPORTANT ===

The lime is incredibly important — I don't think this would work without it. Next time: maybe 2 LIMES.

=== WANT TO TRY ===

- CILANTRO / MINT — the herb fix for the blandness.
- COCONUT FLAKES blended in (rather than using coconut cream). Coconut makes more sense here than silken tofu for protein — this ISN'T supposed to be a protein shake, and that's fine.
- YOGURT might work, but I'm more hesitant on that one.

=== NISHA REFERENCE — CREAMY AVOCADO PEA GAZPACHO ===

Nisha Vora (Rainbow Plant Life): https://rainbowplantlife.com/creamy-avocado-pea-gazpacho/ — she skips the tomato and does avocado, plus (per usual) a lot of other ingredients: coconut milk, a shallot, peas, olive oil, and SERRANO over bell pepper. Her version requires a lot of commitment, so I'm going slow — this recipe is the gradual approach to that destination.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]] / [[chocolate-oatmeal-smoothie]]: the protein-shake smoothies — this one deliberately isn't one.
- [[blender-cheat-meals]]: variant C's non-savory direction (tomatillos/cucumber/bell pepper) is circling the same gazpacho territory from the savory side.
- [[kachumber]]: the cucumber + lime register in salad form (where cucumber + mango worked and tomato left).
original_chef: Mine — a slow approach toward Nisha Vora's creamy avocado pea gazpacho (Rainbow Plant Life).
